extracted.name: Crab & lemon spaghetti with peas
extracted.description: Enjoy this fresh-tasting lunch option, on the table in 20 minutes. It's low in calories but provides folate, fibre, vitamin C and iron
ingredient_lines: 2 leeks (220g), cut into lengths then long thin strips
1 red chilli deseeded and finely chopped
100g fresh white and brown crabmeat (not dressed)
instruction_lines: Cook the spaghetti for 12 mins, or following pack instructions, until al dente. Meanwhile, heat the oil in a large frying pan, add the leeks and chilli and cook for 5 mins. Stir in the garlic, peas, lemon zest and juice, then cook for a few mins.
Drain the pasta, then add to the pan with ¼ mug of pasta water and the crab, then toss everything together until well coated. Spoon into shallow bowls and serve.
